title: BehaviouralDriftSnapshot
description: Multi-signal behavioural drift snapshot for the Predictive Crisis Engine. Captures five drift signal domains — school attendance, caseworker visit notes, incident reports, medication compliance, and communication patterns — to forecast placement disruption 2–4 weeks in advance. Designed for 28-day rolling windows with trend and delta-from-baseline computations. Stored as a JSONB column child of crisis_predictions or in a dedicated behavioural_signals table.

child_id.description: Unique child identifier (e.g. CH-A0427). References children.child_id.

placement_id.description: Active placement workflow ID. References placements.workflow_id.

snapshot_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this snapshot was computed.

window_start.description: Inclusive start of the 28-day rolling lookback window.

window_end.description: Inclusive end of the 28-day rolling lookback window.

weeks_in_placement.description: Total weeks the child has been in the current placement at time of snapshot.

drift_signals.description: Container for all five behavioural drift signal domains. Each signal includes raw observations, computed aggregates, trend, and delta-from-baseline where applicable.

school_attendance.description: School attendance drift signal. Measures attendance frequency, trend over the window, and deviation from the child's baseline attendance rate (computed from the first 4 weeks post-placement).

school_days_total.description: Total school days in the window (excluding weekends, holidays, and school closures).

days_attended.description: Days the child physically attended school.

days_absent_excused.description: Absences with a valid excuse (medical appointment, court date, family visit, etc.).

days_absent_unexcused.description: Unexcused absences (truancy, skip, no-show without notice).

late_arrivals.description: Count of late arrivals (>15 min late) during the window.

early_departures.description: Count of early departures (>15 min early) during the window.

attendance_rate.description: Proportion of school days attended: days_attended / school_days_total.

attendance_trend.description: Slope of a linear regression fitted to weekly attendance rates over the window. Positive means attendance is improving; negative means declining.

baseline_attendance_rate.description: Child's expected attendance rate, computed as the mean attendance rate during the first 4 weeks of this placement (stable reference point).

delta_from_baseline.description: Current attendance_rate minus baseline_attendance_rate. Negative values indicate the child is attending less than their own historical norm.

school_engagement_flags.description: Keyword flags from school liaison reports or teacher check-ins during the window.

caseworker_visits.description: Caseworker home-visit note signal. Analyses sentiment and keyword flags from structured visit notes. Each monthly visit generates a note entry; aggregate statistics are computed across the window.

visit_count.description: Number of caseworker visits during the window (expected 1–4 per month per policy).

entries.description: Individual visit note records. Each entry captures one scheduled or ad-hoc visit.

worker_id.description: Caseworker identifier who conducted the visit.

visit_type.description: Category of visit: routine scheduled check-in, emergency response, or incident follow-up.

note_length_chars.description: Length of the visit note in characters (a proxy for depth of engagement).

sentiment_score.description: NLP-derived sentiment score of the visit note text. -1 = very negative (escalation risk), +1 = very positive (stable/improving).

sentiment_label.description: Bucketed sentiment class derived from sentiment_score thresholds.

keyword_flags.description: Predefined risk-relevant keywords or phrases detected in the note via keyword matching or NER.

note_snippet.description: Truncated excerpt of the original case note for context and audit (no PII beyond what's already in the note).

avg_sentiment.description: Mean sentiment_score across all visit entries in the window.

sentiment_trend.description: Slope of sentiment scores ordered by visit_date. Negative trend means the child/family is deteriorating.

min_sentiment.description: Lowest (most negative) sentiment_score in the window — captures worst-moment signal.

flag_count_total.description: Sum of all keyword flags across all entries in the window.

dominant_flags.description: Top-3 most frequently detected keyword flags, sorted by count descending.

baseline_avg_sentiment.description: Mean avg_sentiment from the first 4 weeks of this placement. Reference point for sentiment drift.

delta_sentiment_from_baseline.description: Current avg_sentiment minus baseline_avg_sentiment. Negative drift signals deteriorating rapport.

incident_reports.description: Incident report signal. Aggregates frequency and severity of reported behavioural or safety incidents across multiple rolling windows to capture both acute and chronic patterns.

incidents_7d.description: Number of incidents reported in the last 7 days (acute signal).

incidents_14d.description: Number of incidents reported in the last 14 days (sub-acute signal).

incidents_28d.description: Number of incidents reported in the full 28-day window (chronic signal).

incidents.description: Individual incident records within the 28-day window.

incident_date.description: Date the incident occurred or was reported.

severity.description: Severity rating: 1 = minor (verbal outburst), 2 = moderate (property damage <$50), 3 = significant (aggression without injury), 4 = severe (physical altercation, police involvement), 5 = critical (self-harm, hospitalisation, runaway).

resolved_within_24h.description: Whether the incident was de-escalated or resolved within 24 hours.

involved_caseworker.description: Caseworker ID who handled or documented the incident.

cumulative_severity_28d.description: Sum of severity scores for all incidents in the 28-day window.

avg_severity.description: Mean severity score across incidents in the window.

severity_trend.description: Slope of severity scores ordered by incident_date. Positive = incidents are getting worse.

baseline_incident_rate.description: Mean weekly incident count during the first 4 weeks of placement. Baseline for frequency comparison.

delta_incident_rate_from_baseline.description: Current weekly incident rate minus baseline_incident_rate. Positive = more frequent than usual.

resolved_fraction.description: Proportion of incidents resolved within 24h. Low values may indicate escalating dysregulation.

medication_compliance.description: Medication compliance signal. Only computed when the child has active prescribed medications. Tracks adherence rates and trends. If the child has no prescriptions, applied=false and all numeric fields are null.

applies.description: False if the child has no prescribed medications. When false, all other fields in this block should be treated as absent/null by the model.

total_doses.description: Total prescribed doses in the window (e.g. twice daily × 28 days = 56).

doses_administered.description: Doses confirmed administered by the foster parent or caregiver.

doses_missed.description: Doses that were not administered (refused, forgotten, or unavailable).

compliance_trend.description: Slope of weekly compliance rates over the window. Negative = child is becoming less compliant.

baseline_compliance_rate.description: Mean compliance rate during the first 4 weeks of placement or medication start.

delta_compliance_from_baseline.description: Current compliance_rate minus baseline_compliance_rate. Negative = adherence is deteriorating.

total_doses.description: Total prescribed doses for this medication in the window.

refusal_incidents.description: Count of documented medication refusal incidents in the window (verbal refusal, hiding, spitting out).

communication_patterns.description: Communication pattern signal. Captures response latency and tone from caseworker–foster-parent digital communication (email, SMS, app-based messaging).

outreach_attempts.description: Number of outbound contacts initiated by the caseworker (phone calls, emails, SMS, app messages) during the window.

responded_count.description: Number of outreach attempts that received a response from the foster parent or child (if age-appropriate).

response_rate.description: responded_count / outreach_attempts. Fraction of caseworker outreaches that got a reply.

missed_contacts.description: Count of unanswered outreaches (no response within 48 hours).

avg_response_lag_hours.description: Mean time-to-response in hours across all responded outreaches.

response_lag_trend.description: Slope of response lag hours over the window. Positive = foster parent is responding more slowly over time.

baseline_avg_lag_hours.description: Mean avg_response_lag_hours during the first 4 weeks of placement.

delta_lag_from_baseline.description: Current avg_response_lag_hours minus baseline_avg_lag_hours. Positive = communication is slowing (potential disengagement).

avg_tone_score.description: Mean NLP sentiment score of written responses (email/SMS body) from the foster parent. -1 = hostile/frustrated, +1 = cooperative/warm.

tone_trend.description: Slope of tone scores over the window. Negative = communication tone is deteriorating (frustration, burnout).

primary_channel.description: Most frequently used communication channel in the window.

after_hours_contacts.description: Number of contacts initiated or responded to outside normal business hours (6pm–8am), which may indicate crisis behaviour.

composite_drift_score.description: Aggregate drift score computed from all five signal domains. Used directly as input features to the XGBoost crisis predictor alongside the existing risk_score, age, and demographic features.

overall_drift_index.description: Weighted composite of all signal deltas and trends. 0 = fully stable (all signals at baseline); 100 = severe drift across all domains. Weighting: incidents 30%, school 20%, sentiment 20%, communication 15%, medication 15% (prorated if medication does not apply).

drifting_signals.description: List of signal domains currently flagged as drifting (delta exceeds ±1 IQR from their own baseline).

signal_trend_direction.description: Aggregate direction of drift across all signals. 'rapidly_declining' triggers immediate supervisor alert.

prediction_window_horizon.description: Forecast horizon for which this snapshot was computed (2 weeks, 3 weeks, or 4 weeks ahead).
